articles.title: US wants Israel to 'crack down' on settler attacks, Rubio says
articles.summary: The United States wants Israel to do more to deter attacks committed by settlers in the West Bank, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday. "We're very disturbed by those images and what we're seeing," Rubio said. "We've asked the Israelis and continue to ask them to crack down on that stuff." articles.title: France demands Israel arrest settlers who attacked French mayor in West Bank
articles.summary: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot demanded Saturday that Israel crack down on “criminal violence” after a French mayor was attacked by Israeli settlers in the West Bank. Bernard Baudoux, mayor of the northern French town of Aulnoye-Aymeries, “was violently assaulted by extremist settlers”, Barrot said on X. “The Israeli authorities must arrest those responsible for these revolting acts and take them to justice. articles.summary: Israeli settlers opened fire at and attacked Palestinian farmers in the village of Deir Jarir, east of Ramallah in the occupied West Bank, Al Jazeera reported.
